visualCharacteristics.summary: Full-viewport inset rounded frame with stacked photos that fade out in turn over a background video; large white title bottom-left, scroll-down link and skip pill
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Landing-page intro heroes with a cycling photo/video stack and title

contentPattern.summary: 7 cycling photos over a background video, title 'Brand Playbook', 'Scroll to explore' (#intro) and 'Skip intro' (#summary) controls
contentPattern.structure: row 1 = background media (pictures, cycled top first, plus an optional link to an MP4 used as the final looping layer); row 2 = H1 title and a paragraph of links (first link = scroll-down control with arrow, second link = skip pill)

usage: Full-viewport intro hero at the top of a landing page. Photos fade out one by one (2.5s each) to reveal the looping muted video. Reduced motion: first photo shown statically.
reuseGuidance: Landing-page intro heroes with a cycling photo/video stack and title
